metricDefinitions.uniqueSourceTriangles: Sum of GLB mesh primitive source indices (or POSITION accessor fallback) divided by three per unique file. Does not count repeated runtime instances or multipass draws.
metricDefinitions.estimatedEmbeddedTextureGpuBytes: Embedded PNG/JPEG map dimensions as RGBA8, multiplied by 4/3 for a full mip-chain estimate. Excludes geometry buffers, RTT/depth/shadow/PMREM targets, driver overhead, transient decode and shared-resource details.
